description: Canonical permission and scopes policy for all Rig Relay integration providers. Enforces least-privilege defaults, mutation gating, scope allowlisting, and telemetry safety across GitHub and Google Drive integrations.

global_rules.description: All integrations start with minimum necessary scopes/permissions. Broader scopes require explicit justification documented in the provider manifest.
global_rules.rationale: Prevents scope creep. Each scope must map to a declared capability.

global_rules.description: Integration state projections, telemetry, and evidence must never contain raw tokens (access, refresh, ID, or installation tokens). Token references use SHA256 hashes only.
global_rules.rationale: Token leakage in projections or telemetry is a critical security risk.

global_rules.description: Integration telemetry must never contain raw private file contents, repository code, document text, or user-generated content. All content-derived fields use SHA256 hashes.
global_rules.rationale: Telemetry is local-first but may be exported. Private content must never leave the local evidence boundary.

global_rules.description: Integration mutation capabilities (write, create, modify) require explicit user approval through the desktop cockpit. No automated write actions without approval gate.
global_rules.rationale: Mutation authority must be receipt-gated to prevent unauthorized changes.

global_rules.description: Mutation capabilities are not available until the profile is unlocked (first-launch profile gate completed).
global_rules.rationale: Profile gate must be completed before any write authority is granted.

global_rules.description: Integration evidence must be content-light. Raw file contents, document text, and code must not appear in evidence artifacts. Use SHA256 hashes for content-derived fields.
global_rules.rationale: Evidence is append-only and may persist beyond session lifetime.

rules.description: GitHub App permissions must be explicit (listed in provider manifest) and scoped to the installation. No broad org-level permissions without explicit declaration.
rules.rationale: GitHub App permission model requires explicit per-repo or per-org scoping.

rules.description: Google Drive scope must not be broad (drive scope or drive.readonly). Use drive.file for app-created and user-selected files only. Broad scope requires explicit justification and is blocked in v1.
rules.required_condition: drive.file scope only; drive and drive.readonly are blocked
rules.rationale: Broad Drive scope exposes all user files. drive.file limits access to app-created and user-selected files.

rules.description: GitHub mutation capabilities (create_check_run_or_status, create_issue_comment, propose_patch_metadata) require profile unlock and explicit user approval before execution.
rules.rationale: Write access to repositories must be governed.

rules.description: Google Drive write capability (write_app_created_evidence_file) requires profile unlock and explicit user approval.
rules.rationale: Write access to Drive must be governed.

rules.description: MCP/ACP tool exports must not expose mutation capabilities while the provider is not_configured or the profile is locked.
rules.rationale: Mutation tools must not be exposed through external protocols without the profile gate.

github.description: GitHub OAuth for identity uses read:user and user:email only. Repo scopes are deferred and require explicit user consent for each integration capability.
github.rationale: Identity OAuth is separate from integration auth. Integration-specific scopes are requested with explicit consent.

google_drive.description: Google Drive integration uses drive.file scope exclusively. OIDC scopes (openid, email, profile) are for identity only.
google_drive.rationale: drive.file provides the minimum necessary access for app-created files without exposing the user's entire Drive.

github.notes: Identity-only scope. Required for basic user profile.
Identity-only scope. Required for email address.

google_drive.notes: Per-file access to files created or opened by the app. Required for Drive integration.

mutation_gate_rules.description: Mutation capabilities require the first-launch profile gate to be completed.
Each mutation action requires explicit user approval in the desktop cockpit. Batch approval is not supported.
